evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (cargo lib+integration, bun, node, typecheck, gallery 166 passed); cargo test preparation::evaluation --lib 3 passed

notes:
Did: preparation/evaluation.rs with pub score(&Observed, &Expected) -> Report. Observed is {selected (context built with an unbounded budget), packed (the real context), draft (as composed), stored (claims then question claims read back through commands::get_briefing, so statuses include deletes and knowledge freshness), latest_versions}. Expected is per reply statement and question: Option<ExpectedCitation {version_id, locator}>. Report (camelCase JSON, integers only): supportedClaims {hit, of} = verified / proposed statements+questions; sourceCorrectness {hit, of} = stored claims whose version and parsed locator equal the expected one / stored claims; staleCitations = claims whose status is not cited (stale or source_unavailable); supersededCitations = document claims whose version is no longer its document's latest; directContextFit {hit, of} = packed manifest tokens / unbounded manifest tokens. Corpus prep-corpus-v1 in tests/fixtures/preparation: corpus.json (3 cases: roomy-budget, tight-budget, replaced-and-deleted, each with a staged reply, expected locators and expected scores) and sources/roadmap.md, notes.txt, notes-v2.txt. Expected offsets and tokens were computed by hand (python str.find, ceil(chars/4)), not from the code. Tests: corpus_scores_to_the_expected_numbers, report_contains_no_passage_text, no_threshold_file_is_part_of_the_corpus.
Assumptions: rates are reported as exact {hit, of} counts, not floats. A QUESTION_LIMIT drop counts as unsupported. Superseded and stale are separate counts. A deleted document's claims count as stale (source_unavailable), not superseded.
Learned: the corpus covers documents only, so ClaimStatus::Stale (knowledge) is never exercised by the corpus; a later item can add a knowledge case through KnowledgeRepository::insert_running_run/finalize_run + append_review. score has no caller outside tests yet. The gallery screen peek-inline-transcript light failed once more in the full gate under load and passed on the rerun.
